text:
Predicates:
ProfessionalWrestlingStable(x) ::: x is a professional wrestling stable.
FormedIn(x, y) ::: x is formed in y.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Includes(x, y) ::: x includes y.
FeudWith(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
ProfessionalWrestlingStable(diamondMine) ∧ FormedIn(diamondMine, WWE) ::: Diamond Mine is a professional wrestling stable, formed in WWE.
Leads(roderickStrong, diamondMine) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(diamondMine, creedBrothers) ∧ Includes(diamondMine, ivyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers, and Ivy Nile.
FeudWith(imperium, diamondMine) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
∃x (ProfessionalWrestlingStable(x) ∧ Leads(roderickStrong, x)) ::: Roderick Strong leads a professional wrestling stable.
